about: Scenes for tools/lol/vfx_render.py: which League VFX systems play where and when for one of our effect tags. Times are League seconds from the scene's start; `frames` gives our tag's frame starts (seconds) and `warp` maps them to League time (pairs [ours, League], linear between); positions are League units in our world (X right / the flight, Y up, Z toward the viewer); camera s = game px per League unit (see vfx_render.py).

lux_e_zone.about: Lucent Singularity's field where the orb lands, then the detonation. Ours: league_lux_fx:e_zone (z -1) plays on the landing point; the zone detonates 60 ticks (1.0 s) after landing (league_lux_e_zone first_delay 60), so the field is removed at 1.0 s and the nova starts. Both systems stand 100 units above the ground (their ground layers sit at -100).

plays.about: the field runs 5x faster: League's 5 s field (it brightens and grows over its life, the flares collapse at its end) in our 1 s

lux_q_orb.about: Light Binding in flight. Ours: league_lux_fx:q_orb, a LinearProjectile picture the game turns to the flight (drawn pointing right, centred on the head), 4 frames x 70 ms looped. Seen from straight above at sprite scale (0.2 px a unit, as our heroes are drawn; at the kit's 0.1 League's orb is a 3-px dot); the missile flies 300 units/s here instead of 1200 so its 0.5 s trails stay as long as our picture's (a projectile's picture never moves by itself). Frames from 0.55 s into the flight. The arch-shaped ground glows are left out: the picture turns with the projectile, a glow on the ground would turn too. Its sparkles (rays, hoop1 / hoop2 bokeh, Sparks_, Left / Left1 motes) are left out too: at 2 px a game px they turned the orb into confetti (tried: dev/q_orb_lod.png).

lux_q_bind.about: Light Binding on the unit it roots. Ours: league_lux_fx:q_bind (z 1, is_follow) for the 90-tick root, 12 frames 1.38 s; League's lasts 2.5 s (rings fade in over 0.25 s, out after 2 s), played 1.8x faster. Its system stands on the unit's feet (rings at 0 and 230 units, rune bars round 130).

lux_r_beam.about: Final Spark. Ours: league_lux_r:beam, the picture of a LineRangeProjectile 340 px long (turned to the cast, drawn centred on the line's middle: the caster 170 px left of the frame's centre), 6 frames over 55 ticks; the damage lands at tick 29 (0.48 s). League charges 1 s (the warning beams) and fires at 1 s: our first 0.467 s show League's first 1.0 s, the rest runs at League's pace. Seen from above, 0.1 px a unit (3400 units = 340 px); the system's origin (League's wand) 10 px in front of the caster.

jinx_zap.about: Zap! in flight. Ours: league_jinx_fx:zap, a LinearProjectile picture (turned to the flight), 4 frames x 50 ms looped, the head at the frame's centre and 28 px of trail behind it. Seen from above at 0.15 px a unit; the bolt flies 1300 units/s here (League: 3300) so its trails stay about our picture's length. Frames from 0.2 s into the flight.

jinx_zap_hit.about: Zap! hitting a unit. Ours: league_jinx_fx:zap_hit (z 1, is_follow), 6 frames x 60 ms. League's hit system stands on the unit (its flashes 100 units up).

jinx_r_rocket.about: Super Mega Death Rocket! in flight. Ours: league_jinx_big:r_rocket, a LinearProjectile picture (turned to the flight), 4 frames x 60 ms looped, 4.5 px a tick. League's rocket (a mesh) with its trail (child Jinx_Base_R_Rocket_Child) and booster, ~2000 units/s; frames 0.4 s into the flight; 0.15 px a unit. Its ground glow, shadow and ground smoke are left out (they would turn with the picture).

jinx_r_blast.about: Super Mega Death Rocket! exploding. Ours: league_jinx_big:r_blast (z 2) on the point hit, 8 frames x 70 ms; the kit's blast is 62 px round (League's 225 + bodies): 0.15 px a unit keeps League's fire cloud about our blast's width. The system stands on the ground.
